select u.id, u.username, u.real_name as realName, u.department_id as departmentId, d.name as departmentName, u.status from `user` u join user_role ur on u.id = ur.user_id join role r on ur.role_id = r.id left join department d on u.department_id = d.id and d.is_del = 0 where u.status = 1 and r.is_del = 0 and r.code = 'HANDLER'
and ( u.username like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or u.real_name like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
order by u.create_time desc
